neptune_lounge.title: Neptune Lounge — Domefront Arrival
neptune_lounge.description: The heart of Triton Central. Warm neon light floods a space buzzing with off-worlders, smugglers, and storytellers. Neptune looms huge through a reinforced viewing dome. The chips smell divine.
ambient_events: A waitress bustles past carrying a sizzling plate of chips, the scent making your mouth water.
A docking flare from the spaceport briefly silhouettes the neon haze through the dome.
A synthwave track glitches and loops momentarily, before correcting itself with a bass drop.
A group of smugglers huddle in a corner, their conversation muffled but intense.
Someone drops a glass — it shatters with a cosmic echo, quickly swept away by a nimble cleaner drone.
return_echoes: For a moment, the lights hesitate — as if the Lounge is quietly confirming you.
The low hum of the dome drifts out of sync, then settles again.
Something in the room seems to pause, just long enough to register your return.
The air carries a faint pressure, like the echo of a decision already made.
A soft flicker ripples across the glass above, unnoticed by anyone else.
The Lounge feels briefly misaligned — as though you arrived a heartbeat earlier than expected.
For an instant, the space around you feels rehearsed… then carries on.

main_square.title: Main Square — Market Confluence
main_square.description: A central plaza under a translucent dome. Traders bark deals in dozens of tongues. Gigs echo from alley venues. A statue of a humanoid with a cracked face plate dominates the square.
ambient_events: A trader yells out an offer in a language you don't understand, but the urgency is universal.
An alley band strikes up a chaotic but catchy rhythm.
A street artist sprays neon graffiti on a service wall, the paint shimmering oddly.
A sudden gust under the dome carries the scent of ozone and roasted spices.
A dome maintenance drone whirs overhead, inspecting the aging transparent panels.

efiishents_office.title: Efiishent's Office
efiishents_office.description: A dim office with curved glass walls and alien ferns. Efiishent keeps strange hours and stranger company. The Dark Rat Queen's perfume still lingers.
ambient_events: A faint whisper in an alien tongue seems to echo from nowhere — or perhaps the plants.
The scent of the Dark Rat Queen's perfume briefly intensifies, then fades like a memory.
A stray light flickers, casting dancing shadows from the ferns and orbs.
You hear a quiet, rhythmic tapping — is it Efiishent meditating, or something else?
A small orb of light floats lazily across the room before dimming into nothingness.

sector_48.title: Sector 48
sector_48.description: A dimly lit maintenance corridor. The hum of Triton Central's infrastructure is louder here.
ambient_events: A low rumble shakes the corridor — somewhere deep, machinery is re-aligning.
Sparks briefly cascade from an exposed wire, hissing before fading out.
The scent of radiant lichen sharpens, almost sweet before turning metallic.
A distant clang reverberates — maintenance or something else moving?
A ventilation fan kicks in suddenly, creating a tunnel of cool air that passes through.

sector_55.title: Sector 55
sector_55.description: A dusty walkway beneath the artificial light of Triton Central. Pipes hum in the walls and distant echoes raise questions.
ambient_events: A deep mechanical thrum pulses through the walkway, felt more than heard.
Footsteps echo briefly — but you see no one ahead or behind.
Water drips methodically from a condensation pipe, the rhythm strangely comforting.
A flickering wall panel struggles to stay lit, casting eerie shadows.
You catch a fleeting glimpse of a maintenance drone disappearing around a bend.

sector_16.title: Sector 16 — Upper Walkway
sector_16.description: An elevated promenade above the Lounge, lined with conduits and observation rails. Triton Central’s pulse feels closer up here.
ambient_events: A soft vibration runs through the rail as a transit pod passes beneath the floor plating.

sector_42.title: Sector 42 — Balcony of Noise
sector_42.description: A mezzanine overlooking the market chaos. Sound bounces weirdly here, like the dome is remembering every shout.
ambient_events: A ripple of applause erupts below for a performer you can’t quite see.

sector_50.title: Sector 50 — Back Corridors
sector_50.description: Narrow corridors behind private rooms. Maintenance panels and hidden service doors suggest more than official routes.
ambient_events: A panel clicks once, as if it almost opened — then decides not to.

sector_54.title: Sector 54 — Junction Walk
sector_54.description: A junction of pipes and footpaths where the hum of Triton Central turns into a steady chant.
ambient_events: A cool draft carries faint echoes of distant music, as if the Lounge is leaking through the walls.

subjunction_12.title: Subjunction 12 — Underworks
subjunction_12.description: Below the main routes, you find underworks where condensation drips and cables hang like vines. The city’s guts, exposed.
ambient_events: Something skitters in the dark, then goes still the moment you listen.
